# v0.5.16 (k3-base) backport fill-ins — generated by version-triage

Base: v0.5.16 public tag (fdebc938f7f4). Each patch git-apply --check VERIFIED against the clean tag by
version-triage worktree; semantic semantics mirror the author's delivered patch at the nearest tag
(features-lead verified at .15p1/.17/.20; these are same-shape clones onto .16's anchors).

- F-4_swa_alloc_decode_v0.5.16.patch  — clone of swa-auditor F-4 (v0.5.15.post1 shape) onto .16 allocator/swa.py
  alloc_decode (:293 anchor). .16 differs from .15p1 only in that alloc_extend already pre-flights; alloc_decode
  lacked the joint guard. Same comment text; same two-call pre-flight.
- FF-1_hi_mamba_min_asym_v0.5.16.patch — clone of swa-auditor FF-1 (v0.5.17 shape) onto .16
  hi_mamba_radix_cache.py check_prefetch_progress (:1863 anchor; .16's region identical to .17's pre-patch).
  Folds raw per-rank mamba hit into the terminate-time MIN reduce, mirrors unified:2021.
- R1-ragged-verify.v0.5.16.patch  — clone of dsa-auditor R1 (.17 shape) onto .16 machinery (ragged_verify.py
  padded_to_bucket had NO cap param at .16; plumbing added: kernel pad_verify_lens_to_bucket +
  PaddedToBucket.execute/.torch kwarg threading + 3 consumer sites (deepseek_v4_backend.py:599,
  flashattention_backend.py:2769, trtllm_mha_backend.py:743). trtllm_mla at .16 does not use
  padded_to_bucket (grep: no site) → no patch line needed.

## IMPORTANT caveats
1. TRITON device path UNCOVERED by R1 hotfix (mirrors dsa's .17/.20 hotfix shape, which caps only the torch
   impl): _padded_to_bucket_kernel still folds uncapped on CUDA in the num_pad_reqs==0 branch. For K3/.16 fleets
   running GPU paths this leaves partial exposure — recommend ALSO backporting the merged HEAD kernel clamp
   (dsa fix train on dev; kernel-side) or running with the torch impl forced (PaddedToBucket.torch path is
   selected when verify_lens.is_cuda is False — i.e., NOT the production default). Fleet call.
2. K3 internal vendor SHAs (87dd4596/bd4828e2) are NOT public; these patches target the public v0.5.16 tag and
   must be re-derived against the vendor fork for the b-numbered fork deltas (mamba files and nixl conn are the
   fork-heavy areas; F-4's swa.py and FF-1's hi_mamba_radix_cache.py are the ones to re-check line-for-line).
3. F-4 at .16 changes only alloc_decode (mirrors .15p1 patch). Do NOT also apply the .15p1 patch at .16; shapes
   overlap region-wise and the .16 one is the correct anchor.
